list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Update dependencies
This commit updates various dependencies to their latest versions.
Notable updates include: - `flutter_local_notifications` to `19.3.0` - `geolocator` to `14.0.1` - `google_maps_flutter` to `2.12.3` - `permission_handler` to `12.0.0+1` - `wechat_assets_picker` to `9.8.0`
New dependencies added: - `sliding_action_button: ^0.0.7` - `flutter_plugin_android_lifecycle: ^2.0.28` - `share_plus: ^11.0.0` - `pretty_qr_code: ^3.5.0` - `qr_code_scanner_plus: ^2.0.10+1`
The Flutter SDK constraint has also been updated.

MESSAGE.value: add news details page update offers view

feat: Add QR scanner for agents and update login flow
- Add QR scanner functionality for agents to validate coupons. - Update login screen UI and flow: - Add toggle for individual/business account types. - Change email input to phone number input. - Remove password field for phone-based login. - Modify map functionality: - Adjust map zoom levels. - Enable scrolling to selected place marker. - Refactor and update various UI components and providers. - Add new translations for QR scanner and related actions.
